scope: One x64 standalone MCP controller routed virtual mouse and keyboard input to two separately owned i686 ordinary Windows EDIT probes using the accepted native-controls policy.
accepted: Both original i686 EDIT targets received independent exact native text (30 characters), retained focus through a two-second idle interval, native Tab to their left EDITs, and simultaneous per-target mouse capture with isolated release. All 22 virtual input calls completed; ordinary Stop, worker and MCP zero exits, probe zero exits, zero holds and private-image absence passed with no cleanup fallback.

preserved_failure.reason: The first runner's local fixture name shadowed its observation function; only three virtual inputs ran before the harness failed. It remains NOT_ACCEPTED.

limits: This accepts the two owned i686 ordinary EDIT fixtures only; arbitrary i686 applications remain untested.
